sources.supportingExcerpt: They will be issued upon arrival with a visitor’s visa for 31 days, free of charge.

sources.title: Agreement between the European Union and Tonga on the short-stay visa waiver
sources.officialityEvidence: EUR-Lex publishes the agreement as an in-force Official Journal treaty. Its defined Member State scope excludes Ireland and the United Kingdom.
sources.supportingExcerpt: visa-free travel for a maximum period of 90 days in any 180-day period

sources.title: Immigration Act, Chapter 10.01 (2020 Revised Edition)
sources.publisher: Attorney General’s Office, Kingdom of Tonga
sources.officialityEvidence: The Attorney General’s Office legislation service publishes this revised Immigration Act and its current index identifies the later 2025 amending Act.
sources.supportingExcerpt: a person who is a Tongan subject shall be entitled to enter the Kingdom

sources.title: Immigration (Amendment) Act 2025
sources.publisher: Attorney General’s Office, Kingdom of Tonga
sources.officialityEvidence: The Attorney General’s Office publishes Act 28 of 2025; it amends section 2 and does not amend the citizen-entry provision used here.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Section 2 of the Principal Act is amended by inserting the following new definitions.

policies.title: Tongan subject: entry without a foreign visitor permit
policies.summary: The Immigration Act expressly entitles a Tongan subject to enter without first obtaining a permit. The same-country ordinary-passport catalog row is normalized as citizenship, not as a foreign visitor visa route.
conditions: The statutory entitlement is for a person who establishes Tongan-subject status; it does not determine treatment of a dual national travelling on a different passport, special travel document, work, residence, diplomatic or admission case.

policies.title: EU citizens: treaty short-stay visa-free travel
policies.summary: The in-force EU–Tonga agreement gives the named EU-nationality cohort visa-free short stays of up to 90 days in any 180-day period. The treaty’s Member State definition excludes Ireland and the United Kingdom; Croatia is included.
conditions: The agreement applies to citizens travelling for a maximum 90 days in any 180-day period and excludes remunerated activity.
The treaty rule takes precedence over the Revenue and Embassy’s more general arrival-visitor wording for these mapped EU citizens.
This does not establish work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, special-document, security-screening or individual admission treatment.

policies.title: Consensus named foreign passports: visitor visa issued on arrival
policies.summary: Both live Tongan Government schedules name this ordinary-passport cohort for a visitor visa issued on arrival. This is normalized as visa_on_arrival; the sources’ 30-day and 31-day descriptions are not reconciled into a duration claim.
conditions: Revenue states issuance is conditional on a valid return ticket and sufficient funds; entry remains subject to immigration decision.
The Embassy says the visa is issued on arrival; its separate prior-authority pathway for unlisted travellers is not included in this consensus cohort.
This policy does not establish employment, business, study, residence, transit, diplomatic, official or special-document treatment.
